sources.supportingExcerpt: The following documents are also required to obtain an Embassy/Consulate/Tasheer visa

policies.title: Saudi ordinary visitor route for the current noneligible nationality cohort
policies.summary: Visit Saudi's live country selector maps these passports to its noneligible group. For an ordinary visitor without qualifying third-country visa or residence documents, the selection-specific OTHER result requires an advance Embassy, Consulate or Tasheer visa.
conditions: Ordinary passport and short tourism baseline without a qualifying U.S., U.K. or Schengen business/tourist visa or residence permit, GCC residence, integrated travel package, pilgrimage route or airline stopover product.

The live official nationality record maps each named passport to visaGroup noneligible. The selection-specific OTHER response then presents Embassy/Consulate/Tasheer visa requirements and the Saudi Foreign Ministry embassy finder.

The advance application requires a passport valid at least six months beyond entry, proof of residence, return ticket, employment and financial evidence, itinerary, identification and a Saudi accommodation address.

Conditional eVisa or visa-on-arrival routes for qualifying third-country visa or residence holders do not replace this ordinary passport-only baseline. Issuance and final admission remain discretionary.

policies.title: Saudi package tourist eVisa for six current nationalities
policies.summary: Visit Saudi's live selector maps these six passports to Visa by Package. Its selection-specific OTHER result offers an instant tourist eVisa through integrated packages from qualified travel agencies.
conditions: The traveller must purchase an integrated package through a qualified agency, including a licensed hotel rated four stars or above, round-trip flight, online visa application and medical insurance.
The published package criteria include a minimum value, a two-to-88-day duration, adult and child composition limits, and travel beginning at least 48 hours after purchase.
The package route excludes Makkah and Madinah. It is not a visa exemption, visa on arrival or unsponsored electronic entitlement.
Passport validity, security review, carrier checks and final admission remain separate. The standard Embassy/Consulate route remains an alternative.

application.label: Visit Saudi package visa
application.processingTime: Travel must begin at least 48 hours after completing the package purchase.
steps: Choose a qualified travel-agency package that satisfies the published hotel, flight, value and duration criteria.
Complete the online visa application and medical insurance through the integrated package provider.
Wait for the electronic tourist visa before travel and retain the approved travel-package documents.
